reason: Document B wins my trust as a cautious backer by actually doing the math on the funding goal (which otherwise looks like a shortfall on 1,500 copies) and being disarmingly honest that 23 ratings is a small sample size. Document A not only leaves the funding math unexplained, but also claims the game was tested at 'hundreds of tables' and brings up stretch goals, which makes me nervous for a first-time creator.
